measurement.active_failure_scope: One collection-time failure on an active desktop worker; same coordinator, surviving original laptop assignment.
measurement.scope: Explicit restart, worker cgroup OOM survivor retry, all-worker loss, active native reorg cancellation and late stale-root rejection pass. GPU VRAM/spill exhaustion and automatic supervision/replacement remain pending.
measurement.supervision_scope: sealed count-four native candidates; one real trial per fault

restart_reorg_and_resource_failure_recov.reason: All five recovery cases required by the current throughput contract have retained native evidence. Automatic sealed-candidate fleet replacement and supervisor adoption now pass. scope: The optimized single-GPU 16, 32 and 64-input capacity sequence passed. Complete cold-start, post-seal and sustained delivery qualification remain separate.

typed_local_dag.persistent_dispatch_qualified_scope: Count eight on each GPU and one concurrent assignment, with one independent DAG owner per GPU; shared-owner native arrival integration remains open.

typed_native_active_failover.scope: One native four-transaction candidate survived SIGKILL of an active desktop GPU worker after another subtree had been accepted. The same coordinator retained that proof, confirmed exact process/cgroup exit, revoked the lease, released the workspace and retried on the surviving laptop GPU under its original assignment.

typed_native_arrival_intake.scope: One explicit prepared, sealed selection in an isolated native journal. Late arrival persisted during proving; no candidate assembly from pending arrivals or pre-seal dispatch.
typed_native_arrival_intake.timing_scope: One isolated prepared count-four selection; existing wallet proofs reused. No pre-seal dispatch, timing speedup, active proving recovery or sustained throughput qualification.

typed_native_cached_recovery.scope: One native count-four journal through epochs one to four: active-subtree interruption, incomplete cached-only rejection with zero GPU starts, GPU continuation from that rejected epoch, interruption after accepted final root before native application, and CPU-only cached native continuation.

typed_native_context_repetitions.host_ready_endpoint: bounded above by final controller exit

typed_native_coordinator_recovery.scope: One explicit coordinator SIGKILL during native count-four GPU proving; original journal resumed at epoch two with exact old process/cgroup reconciliation, one CPU-reverified accepted subtree, three fresh recursive proofs, one CPU-audited root and one isolated native application.

typed_native_deferred_arrivals.scope: One count-four candidate at height eleven: two old-head arrivals revalidated, two current-head arrivals selected, and three invalid entries retained outside the candidate. Original receipts and retry responses are unchanged.
typed_native_deferred_arrivals.timing_scope: One isolated revalidated height-eleven candidate. Baseline height ten used a retained root. All wallet proofs reused. Four fresh recursive proofs. No pre-seal dispatch, active recovery, matched speedup or sustained throughput qualification.

typed_native_pending_candidate.scope: One current-head FIFO selection built from stored transaction/proof bytes, with independent native policy preflight and CPU wallet authentication. No policy-aware reordering or stale-arrival rebinding.
typed_native_pending_candidate.timing_scope: One isolated count-four candidate assembled from pending bytes. Existing wallet proofs reused. Four fresh recursive proofs. No pre-seal dispatch, matched speedup, active recovery or sustained throughput qualification.
